annotation.title_clean: 苏州市智能车联网发展促进条例
annotation.title_en: Suzhou Municipal Regulations on Promoting the Development of Intelligent Connected Vehicles (Internet of Vehicles)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Suzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee (approved by Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee)
annotation.summary_en: Suzhou's local regulation, effective 1 December 2023, promotes the intelligent connected vehicle industry. It covers industrial support, V2X infrastructure, road testing and commercial deployment of autonomous vehicles, and safety, data and cybersecurity duties. It also covers insurance and a voluntary social risk fund.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines intelligent connected vehicles by conditional, high and full automation levels and supports their road testing, demonstration and commercialisation.
Allocates responsibilities across industry, police traffic, transport, data, market regulation and cyberspace authorities.
Autonomous test vehicles must record data, allow online monitoring, carry visible markings, and upload data to a municipal platform.
Requires data classification and protection, in-country storage of personal and important data, and security assessment for exports.
Requires compulsory traffic liability insurance plus commercial insurance, and encourages a social risk fund to compensate victims where liability is unclear.
